name: The Islander

meta.start: Wu Shen, Kelv Sternhammer  Baltus Fowler, Torm Ragetotem, Sorek

summary: The Islander is an invitation extended by veteran warrior trainers across Azeroth to those who have proven their basic mettle in battle. It directs rising fighters to Fray Island off the Merchant Coast, where an insular brotherhood of warriors tests their peers in raw martial combat. Meeting the chief warrior Klannoc Macleod marks a pivotal step toward mastering advanced combat disciplines.

sections.title: A Gathering of Blades
sections.body: Warrior trainers in capital cities across both the Alliance and the Horde recognize when a student has outgrown basic drills. Rather than formal rank or political loyalty, martial progression demands that combatants measure themselves against true peers. The journey sends warriors away from civilized sparring yards toward a rugged isle isolated in the Great Sea.

sections.title: Fray Island and the Merchant Coast
sections.body: Fray Island sits east off the Merchant Coast, just south of the goblin port of Ratchet in the Barrens. It is reached by swimming the waters over submerged sandbar shallows. On this rock, political ties dissolve in favor of martial fraternity; fighters gather under the gaze of Klannoc Macleod, the chief warrior on the isle, awaiting whatever brutal trial he deems necessary.

faq.answer: Fray Island is a rocky outcrop located off the Merchant Coast of the Barrens, south of Ratchet. It serves as an isolated proving ground where warriors from across Azeroth gather to hone their craft, spar, and face grueling combat trials away from civil authority.

Klannoc Macleod is the chief warrior presiding over Fray Island. He assesses hopeful contenders who make the journey to the island, deciding whether their spirit and skill are worthy of being guided further along the warrior's path.

faq.q: Why do trainers from both Horde and Alliance send warriors here?
aliases: why do both factions go here
faq.answer: True martial mastery transcends faction boundaries. Master trainers in Orgrimmar, Stormwind, Thunder Bluff, and Ironforge recognize that raw martial skill must be tested in unbridled combat, and Fray Island exists as an unspoken proving ground for any warrior capable of surviving its challenges.

faq.q: How do you reach Fray Island from the mainland?
aliases: how to get to fray island
faq.answer: Travel south along the Merchant Coast from the port town of Ratchet in the Barrens. From the shoreline, navigate the sandbar shallows and swim east across the open water toward the island.

faq.q: What happens after meeting Klannoc Macleod?
faq.answer: Once Klannoc confirms you have made the journey and evaluates your resolve, he invites you to participate in The Affray—a gauntlet designed to test your combat stamina against waves of challengers.

angles.text: This rite of passage is exclusive to warriors, marking the crucial transition from learning basic maneuvers to unlocking the full ferocity and tactical versatility of veteran stances.
Starting from Thunder Bluff or Orgrimmar, Horde warriors journey down to the Barrens to prove their strength beyond the watchful eyes of their chieftains.
Alliance warriors must journey across the sea or through Kalimdor's wilderness to reach Fray Island, demonstrating martial devotion in a rugged frontier far from human and dwarven strongholds.
